posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked:
I would just like to say how satisfying that update was.  I expected GtG to dribble out updates on the rewards that had been unlocked because, why woudln't they?  They've got a month to fill for that Kickstarter.  Instead, they just vomitted out a TON of fantastic art and information all in one go on the very first day of the KS.  The more I scrolled down that page, the better it got.

I have to admit, I'm pretty replete right now, not overly hungry for those mystery $450k+ levels.  If it all ended after the La Capitan and Deadline reveals (because that's totally what those are), I'll be good.  That was quite a banquet and I'm happily stuffed right now.

posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked:
Why wouldn't the complete hero variant collection include Completionist Guise?  He's just a hero variant like everyone else, right?

EDIT: maybe it's this text that's confusing?

At $150k, we add some awesome tokens and a more complete complexity/difficulty chart to the Ultimate Collector Case, and also add in a very special hero variant for Guise: 

The "and also" tells me the two are not tied.  They added tokens to the Box and separately, made an alt of Guise.

posts.name: DerpTheBugbear
posts.cooked:
Spiff:

Why wouldn't the complete hero variant collection include Completionist Guise?  He's just a hero variant like everyone else, right?

EDIT: maybe it's this text that's confusing?

At $150k, we add some awesome tokens and a more complete complexity/difficulty chart to the Ultimate Collector Case, and also add in a very special hero variant for Guise:   
The "and also" tells me the two are not tied.  They added tokens to the Box and separately, made an alt of Guise.

That could just as easily be read as…

They added tokens to the box and also Completionist Guise to the box as well.

I think it's the inclusion of the word "in"…   Completionist Guise was added "in" to what?  The box is what they were just talking about, so presumably that's what it was added "in" to.

 

Edit: In any case, I always like to make sure of the little things like this while the kickstarter is still going on.  I've been burned before by vague wordings and things left unsaid when it comes to kickstarters.  It really sucks to back something, then suddenly when it shows up at your door and you open it, you are missing something that you fully expected to receive.
